summary: Per-frame AI pit-state forcing call on an F1CVehicle. For race sessions (dword_7C56A4 == 7) it only acts when the current lap (+0x403C) is not the last lap (dword_8ACF8C - 1) AND TeammatePartValueLookup returns 0, 4, or FinishState (+0x4064) equals 1; on pass it runs StateConditionalAction on the pit controller (this+3251) and returns AIStateFlagSetter(1). For non-race sessions it runs the same two calls unconditionally. When blocked it returns the last-lap or teammate value.

local_names.result: default/blocked return (last-lap value or teammate value)

operations.description: If session type dword_7C56A4 == 7, take the race-session path; otherwise force exit unconditionally.
Compute the last-lap value as dword_8ACF8C - 1.
If lapNumber at +0x403C (this[4111]) is not the last lap, continue to the teammate check; otherwise stay blocked.
Call TeammatePartValueLookup(this + 3251) on the pit controller and keep the result.
Proceed only if the teammate lookup result is 0, is 4, or FinishState at +0x4064 equals 1 (guard:0).
Call StateConditionalAction(this + 3251) on the pit controller.
Call AIStateFlagSetter(1) and return its result on the pass path.
Non-race path: call StateConditionalAction(this + 3251) and return AIStateFlagSetter(1).
When blocked (race path but not passing the guards), return the previously computed result (last-lap value or teammate value).

The pit controller pointer this+3251 (byte offset +0x32CC) is passed to both callees but is not packet-listed as a field; only the raw source indexes it.
